summary.text: Sylvia Santana is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate, and her caucus biography says she is serving her second term.
Her biography says she has worked on reforming the state's justice system for adults and juveniles and on local government and school funding.

paragraphs.text: Santana majored in finance at Eastern Michigan University and earned a bachelor's degree in business.
She and her husband, Harvey, live in Warrendale with their three children.
